open_points.text: _run_backup: [BEHAVIOR] The run's backup step MUST call store.copy_store_snapshot with registry_store and a new temporary path, ask configuration.give_backup_key for the key, make the BackupRecord from the imported BACKUP_RECORD_VERSION constant, the StoreSnapshot's fixed_at as its made_at and its last_sequence_number, the imported RELEASE_VERSION constant and _key_digest of the key, write _encrypt_backup of the copy's bytes into a second new temporary file, and remove the unencrypted copy, with its write-ahead log, shared-memory and rollback-journal companion files, before going on; when copy_store_snapshot answers SnapshotFailed, the step MUST remove what it wrote at that path before it reports.

open_points.subject: _run_backup integrity-check step
open_points.text: _run_backup: [BEHAVIOR] The backup step MUST then read the written backup back from its file, decrypt it with _decrypt_backup into a third new temporary file, call store.check_store_file on that file with the recorded last sequence number, and remove that file with its write-ahead log, shared-memory and rollback-journal companion files, whatever the check answered; the backup MUST be renamed to its kept name only when the snapshot, the encryption, the decryption and the check passed and both unencrypted files were removed, and otherwise the step MUST delete the backup when it can, leaving it under its temporary name when the decrypted file cannot be removed, and report the MAKE_BACKUP member of = models.BackupRunStep, a file it cannot remove or delete staying under the temporary prefix for the next run.

open_points.subject: _run_backup rotation step
open_points.text: _run_backup: [BEHAVIOR] The run's rotation step MUST run whatever the backup step did, read clock.recorded_now once before it looks at any file and take one cutoff, that instant less the imported BACKUP_RETENTION_HOURS constant in hours; it MUST then take the regular files directly in backup_dir whose name begins with the imported BACKUP_KEPT_PREFIX constant in the order of their names and delete each whose record _read_backup_record cannot read and each whose made_at is earlier than the cutoff, comparing to the microsecond with neither side rounded, so that a backup made exactly at the cutoff is kept.
open_points.question: Must the note require the directly imported recorded_now symbol, or must IMPORTS provide an app.clock module binding named clock?

open_points.subject: run_daily_backup_if_due
open_points.text: run_daily_backup_if_due: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST read clock.recorded_now once per call and ask _backup_due with that instant; only when it answers true and no run of this process is going MUST it start _run_backup with backup_dir, registry_store and the UTC date of that instant on a thread of its own, naming _run_backup through the module's own name at the moment of the call, and return at once, never waiting for the run; a call while a run is going MUST start none, so that runs never overlap, and the flag that a run is going MUST be set by the call that starts the run and cleared by _run_backup when it ends, on every path, under a lock.

open_points.subject: _read_backup_record
open_points.text: _read_backup_record: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST open file_path for reading only without following a link, by Linux's no-follow open flag of the os module, named directly and never probed for, since Registry runs on Linux alone (A20), read only its first line, and answer a BackupRecord when that line is a UTF-8 JSON object with exactly the fields of = models.BackupRecord, each of its type, made_at an instant written as text of a date written as text of four ASCII digits, a hyphen, two ASCII digits, a hyphen and two ASCII digits that names a real calendar date by its year, month and day, the capital letter T, two ASCII digits each of the hour, the minute and the second separated by colons, optionally a full stop and one to six ASCII digits of a fraction of a second, and an offset that is the capital letter Z or a plus or minus sign with two ASCII digits each of hours and minutes separated by a colon, naming a real time of that day, taken as UTC to the microsecond and no integer field a boolean, whatever its record_version; it MUST answer None, without raising, for a file that is not a regular file or cannot be opened or read, and for any other first line.
open_points.rule: - Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: State the required no-symbolic-link behavior without prescribing Linux's os-module no-follow flag or the exact probing implementation.

open_points.subject: _run_backup artifact policy
open_points.text: _run_backup: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST touch in backup_dir only regular files directly in it whose name begins with the imported BACKUP_KEPT_PREFIX constant or the imported BACKUP_TEMPORARY_PREFIX constant, MUST follow no symbolic link, by Linux's no-follow open flag of the os module, named directly and never probed for, since Registry runs on Linux alone (A20), and enter no directory there, and MUST create each temporary file exclusively under the temporary prefix with a name no other file has; it MUST write nothing to the store and make no audit entry.
open_points.rule: - Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
open_points.question: Retain the path-safety and no-symbolic-link requirements but remove the prescribed os-module flag and probing implementation.

open_points.subject: probe_backup_location
open_points.text: probe_backup_location: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST create one new regular file directly in backup_dir, created exclusively and without following a link, by Linux's no-follow open flag of the os module, named directly and never probed for, since Registry runs on Linux alone (A20), under a name that begins with the imported BACKUP_TEMPORARY_PREFIX constant and that no file of the location has, and MUST then remove that same file, touching no other file of the location.
open_points.rule: - Реализацию: не пиши алгоритм построчно, пиши требования к поведению
